<assessment>SOURCE shows a tall gridded tower descending through planted setbacks toward a connected low wing and left block, with pale primary framing, recessed glazing, selected outdoor pockets and darker lower glazing zones. CURRENT 10–12 retain these principal connections and now show clear tower recesses and connected low-wing terraces. The strongest remaining mismatch is the charcoal primary grid across the left lower elevations. Rear construction and concealed joints are unverified; no definite slab penetration or floating railing is established. Context removal conflicts with earlier neighbor-retention intent and remains unresolved; restoration is not requested here.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="front">problem: CURRENT 10/12 turns the projecting frame across several lower floors of the left block and connecting wing into a broad charcoal band. SOURCE retains pale primary framing around the darker recessed glazing, producing a lighter, more continuous structural grid.
action: Locally correct the affected projecting beams and columns to the source-supported pale finish. Retain darker recessed glazing and secondary mullions, existing bay divisions, floor elevations and connected terrace assemblies.</issue>
<keep>Corrected pale tower beams and columns.
Existing six-front/five-side tower subdivisions.
Completed tower recesses with visible side returns and supported glass guards.
Connected low-wing terrace decks and recessed outdoor pockets.</keep>
